correctness.rationale: At finite mass the zero-range ring stationary weight is proportional to product r_i^{-eta_i}; direct incoming/outgoing flux gives invariance. Summing ordinary sites against independent geometric(q) variables yields P(K1=j,K2=k)=e^{b_L j}p_L(M-j-k)/D and J/q=1-[sum_t e^{b_L t}p_L(M-t)]/D. In the condensed regime, LLN and uniform Riemann sums give a tilted-uniform U on [rho-mu] and L(1-J/q)->e^{theta alpha}/I_theta(alpha). At critical density a local geometric CLT on t=O(sqrt L) and exponential lower-tail domination yield density e^{theta x}phi_sigma(h-x-y)/A and correction B/A. The equal-bias h=0 case has Rayleigh total with scale sigma. Independently inspected verify.py tests exact state-balance and current for 28 finite models; such tests only corroborate the analytic limits.
residual_risks: Finite-state numerical calculations do not prove either asymptotic law.
